steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Doctor! We have to take Amiya and go!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Shining can't hold Theresis off for long!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The drone—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Grab the zipline, Doctor! We'll go as far as we can!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'll punch them, if worse comes to worst.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't like fighting, if I can help it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But Theresa pulled me out of that attic. Amiya and Kal'tsit taught me responsibility.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm a Vampire too.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If it's for you, I...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Closure! Over here!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Time to move, Doctor. The zipline's ready. Give me your hand!
A burst of light explodes as the sword pierces the ground.
Time stops in an instant.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: ...Confessarius witchcraft.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: General!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Dame Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: She approaches the end of this cycle.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Rhodes Island's Cautus was rescued. The Sanguinarch of Vampires is pursuing the Banshee and Ascalon.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: What of Theresa?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I just received Her Highness's signal, general.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's ready.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Good.
The Regent looks up at the overcast sky and the walls in the distance.
The true battlefield of the Sarkaz lies beyond the walls.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: It's time to begin.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Are you ready?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There's nothing to make ready.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Right, we're finally here.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina, I must—

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We must bear witness to all this.
An elaborate black structure lies at the end of the tunnel.
Generation after generation, the greatest minds in Victoria came together to build it.
All this, just to hold a sword.
If few are the heroes who can use it to conquer Catastrophe, then let humanity use its wisdom to raise a shield against the storm.
These structures, the entire building, was made for this.
The voices rise up again.
The calls are no longer urgent, no longer sharp, no longer attempting to persuade or incite.
She feels a tired sense of peace.
She has been here before. She has been guided to this place, long before her memories took shape.
Just like then, she knows where she must go, what she must take.
It is right there, in the middle of the room, unguarded, so unremarkable it might as well have been a tiny decoration in this grand building.
Kyngasycath, the Sighs of Kings.
It lay there and continues to do so, over the centuries, through countless reforgings.
Siege extends a hand towards it.
Broken shadows fill the space, rising and ebbing, resonating.
Alexandrina. Alexandrina Vina Victoria. They whisper her name.
She touches the sword.
Shards of days gone by pass through her body. She hears a boom in her mind.
Suddenly, she understands.
She is the source of all those visions and sounds.
They are her doubts, confusion, regrets, recollections.
Things she has forgotten, and things she intentionally forgot.
A great hand raises her. Londinium stands up from beneath her, taking her across the land of Victoria.
The land that she and her friends walked.
Countless voices superimpose upon one another.
Victoria, Victoria.
This is Victoria.
Her Victoria.
The voices call out.
Siege opens her eyes. There are no illusions now, no tides. She holds in her hand the Sighs of Kings, symbol of the Victorian monarchy.
There is little to show that it is a sword of legend. It is unremarkable in size and design.
It looks like an ordinary sword.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You have the Sighs of Kings, Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's... lighter than I expected.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Let's go. Time to go home.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We—
Siege wants to turn around and feel the sword's warmth with her friends.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Don't.
But she feels a colder blade in her back.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Allerdale.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Please! Don't. Don't turn around.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Give me the sword.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Your Highness Alexandrina... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I have to...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I have to do this.
Allerdale's voice is calm, but filled with a terrible, resolute sorrow.
Siege recalls the 'memoirs' that Morgan wrote in jest.
A handful of pages, clumsily written, with less-than-elegant vocabulary.
The story starts with a fictional fight. Everyone returns to base after the fight. Allerdale makes a cream stew for them in the story.
She laughs in her heart. Allerdale made a stew, yes, but what the memoirs omitted is that...
It did not exactly taste great.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Oh—!

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You... you too...

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: I don't want to hurt you.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: But I have a debt to pay.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Our mission is to help Allerdale remove the sword from the Mausoleum of Kings.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Finish this job, and I can retire.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: It was an offer I couldn't refuse.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We just mourned the heroes who fell victim to betrayal together.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I thought you would understand.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: But in the end, you're no different from them.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm ashamed I thought about trusting you, even for a moment.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Like I said, living is hard.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: I'm sorry. I want all of us to keep on living. I'll try to make sure we do just that.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: We've both been pushed out of death's way by our friends.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Unfortunately, our paths happen to diverge this time.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Your Highness.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Please hand over the Sighs of Kings, for your own safety.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is this the only way?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I betrayed your trust. There's nothing I can say about that.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You can admonish me, reproach me, try to defeat me. You have the right to do so.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But I will leave with the sword.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This is my... destiny... in Londinium.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You said the Sighs of Kings would protect Londinium from the storm.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I don't want to drag Londinium into the abyss either. I won't let her fall into Sarkaz hands.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Into the hands of the dukes, then.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Whoever is behind you wants to use the Sighs of Kings to intimidate the other dukes and subjugate them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They don't care about protecting Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We may be meek, but we're in the middle of all this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: With the people who have been hurt and abused.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I know what she's after, but it doesn't concern me.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm only doing... I only care about what I can actually influence.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What about the Self-Salvation Corps?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You built it with Clovisia. You protected it with your honor.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I have no honor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then you protected it with your life.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What do I tell the Corps fighters, if you're really going to leave?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Clovisia will handle it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I no longer have the strength to care about what they think of me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You claim you only care about what you can influence.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Aren't you underestimating what you already have?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What does one dare to have, when you know it's only a matter of time before you lose it?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What does one dare to reveal, when what everyone trusts and respects is just an illusion?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What can one hold on to, when you realize this is the one and only end of your path?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This isn't even the outcome of a choice.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I simply ended up here. Fate has pushed me to this place, before I even realized it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We could never have walked together.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We met when we were little, didn't we?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: At Cumberland Manor.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I thought you had forgotten.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I almost had... I was with Gawain that day.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The creature that was like the sun told us we would meet again, someday.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But he could not have guessed that it would end this way.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You won't give me the sword, Vina.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Then swing it. We must bear witness...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Remember my promise?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Enough! Say no more.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I carry nothing on my shoulders. I'll just be your brain trust.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sorry... I forgot you had Morgan.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'll just be a thug then.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We'll bomb the Sarkaz camp together. You light a fire, and I'll kick their commander's arse once there's smoke.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm joking.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My path is long determined, Vina.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Why do you say that? You're still with us. The Glasgow Gang has more stories to write.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The answer is yes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll make sure you come back unharmed after kicking that commander's arse.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's my promise.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's not a joke. Never has been, never will be.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We'll all make it out of this in one piece.
A sound breaks the stalemate.
Was it an illusion?
Siege looks around. The massive statues remain still in the shadows. None of the dead Sarkaz come back to life.
Again.
Nearby, right in front of her.
The sound of steam gushing, increasingly rapid.
Increasingly loud, increasingly clear, until it fills the entire space.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: W-What's that?
Allerdale's heart skips a beat.
She can feel it.
The premonition of fate echoes again cruelly.
